name: Cable Single-Arm Decline Fly
steps: Lie back with your feet secured on a decline bench beside a low cable and hold the handle above your lower chest.
Open the working arm toward the pulley in a broad arc.
Sweep your hand back over your lower chest.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your elbow angle steady and your torso still.
Stop lowering your arm when your upper arm aligns with your chest.
